scheme_name: Attendance Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students with Disabilities of Rural Areas
other_conditions: Family monthly income must not exceed ₹5,000
Disability must be 40% or above as per RPwD Act 2016
Applicant must be a girl student from 1st Standard onwards
Eligibility category noted in source: persons with disabilities
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹2,500 per annum up to 10th standard and ₹3,000 per annum for higher education, credited online to the student's bank account.
